No option can be put forward yet, because the model could not test your “monthly churn < 4%” limit.

- The price scenarios were compared and the result held up under the changes tested, but that is not a check that any scenario meets the churn ceiling.
- The comparison rests on four Olumi-supplied estimates, including Pro subscriber count, conversions, churn and other-plan MRR; they are assumptions, not recorded measurements.
- Pro subscriber count is the model’s strongest structural driver, with source recorded as an Olumi inference.
